hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes extending toward the overpass

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions and Shadows
hazards.description: The overpass structure and dense vegetation on the left create deep shadows and potential blind spots for drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Underneath and around the highway overpass structure

hazards.name: Leaning utility pole
hazards.description: A wooden utility pole is leaning at a severe angle over the roadway and potential pedestrian path, posing a structural risk.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, crossing the sky

hazards.name: Isolated industrial frontage
hazards.description: The lack of active land use and 'eyes on the street' increases personal safety risks and creates an uninviting environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Background, right side

hazards.name: Absence of sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or on unpaved shoulders, directly exposed to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area

hazards.name: Inadequate lighting
hazards.description: Sparse street lighting is insufficient to provide adequate visibility for pedestrians at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road in the foreground

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of a sidewalk or paved walkway forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven, unmaintained terrain.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the roadside

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk is very narrow, providing minimal space for pedestrians to pass one another or maintain distance from the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the road, running parallel to the fence
